title: 第15章 视角不同追求不同第16章 分家将亡
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
视角不同，追求不同。
深夜，楚夷房间。
“楚大力”楚夷看着信纸上的操练完毕与进城的命令，眼中彷佛有火光闪烁。
那是名为野心的烈火。
他知道，这是上天给自己的一个机会，只要成了，以後这整个矿山都是他的天下了。
甚至只要军阵成了，清风城与主家，甚至在这之上的路，他也可以想一想了。
越想，楚夷的呼吸声就越沉重，这个诱惑太大了了，大到他不敢置信的掐了自己一下。
“不是梦。”楚夷喃喃道，疼痛让楚夷回过神，他看着高挂在夜幕之上的月亮，垂下眸，把信纸放在烛火之上。
信纸被火焰燃起，吞噬，楚夷只是拿着信纸，看着火焰引燃到自己的指尖，烈火的炙烤让他如获新生。
而後，楚夷看着已经变为灰烬的信纸，摩挲了一下自己的指尖。
“明天得让楚大力忙一会了。”楚夷淡淡道。
而另一边。
树林，河里。
“他娘的，楚二那种小人，成不了一点大事。”被“抛尸”的中年男人从河里爬起来，正了正自己的脖颈怒骂。
他知道自己会“死”但没想到楚二这伪君子，居然连银子都是口头上说说了事。
他居然真的一锭银子都没给自己。
“还好我会苟。”中年男人甩了甩身上的水，慢悠悠的走入树林，抄着小道往李家走去。
李家，大厅。
“你这是什麽本领？”李君肃看着下面讲述的中年男人，正了正神色。
他发现自己好像有些小瞧这个世界了，被扭断了脖子还能活蹦乱跳的，哪怕在高武世界，也有点骇人听闻了。

“看来以後杀人还得要毁尸灭迹啊。”李君肃想着。
“这就是小人的一点点小机缘了。”中年男人谦虚的说道。
“易筋，他应该是得到了残篇或≈x4b7e;机缘巧合下偷师了，这还是很少见的。”李武看着严肃的李君肃解释。
“嘿嘿，大人真是见多识广。”中年男人有些不好意思的挠了挠头。
“长春，给他再加十两，我希望这件事不要有任何人知道。”李君肃先是对着下面的李长春说道，而後看着中年男人笑眯眯的开口。
“放心吧李大人，在您的计划完成之前，我不会在城郊露面了。”中年男人闻言，看着李君肃认真无比。
“很好，你是个聪明人，所以留个联络方式，以後李家还会有用到你的地方的。”李君肃满意的看了眼中年男人。
“我在”中年男人老实说出自家地址。
“很好，你可以走了。”李君肃点了点头，而後一挥手。
等到中年男人离开后。
“少爷，如此放走他人”李武看着李君肃欲言又止。
“武伯放心吧，他刚刚才死在楚夷手下，现在回去”李君肃闻言笑着摇了摇头。
李武闻言，也是回过了神。
这中年男人活蹦乱跳的跑回去通风报信，那就会真的死翘翘了。
“为什麽动不动就要杀人灭口呢？”李君肃看着下方的李武跟李长春，有些无奈的想着。
而做着计划打算把楚家全歼的李君肃并没自己才是最狠的人的自觉。
在李君肃看来，楚家一旦内乱，那麽楚家上下，奴仆老少，一个不留。
只要不是敌人，那麽李君肃就会有让人钦佩不已的人格魅力。

content_en:
Different perspectives, different pursuits.
Late at night, Chu Yi's room.
"Chu Dali" Chu Yi looked at the completion of training and the order to enter the city written on the letter, as if there was a flash of fire in his eyes.
That is the fire called ambition.
He knew that this was an opportunity given to him by God. As long as he succeeded, the entire mine would be his world from now on.
Even as long as the military formation is completed, he can think about Qingfeng City and the main family, and even the road above it.
The more he thought about it, the heavier Chu Yi's breathing became. The temptation was so great that he pinched himself in disbelief.
"It's not a dream." Chu Yi murmured. The pain brought Chu Yi back to his senses. He looked at the moon hanging high in the night, lowered his eyes, and placed the letter on top of the candlelight.
The letter was ignited and swallowed by the flames. Chu Yi just held the letter and watched the flames ignite on his fingertips. The burning of the fire made him feel like he was reborn.
Then, Chu Yi looked at the letter that had turned into ashes and rubbed his fingertips.
"Chu Dali will have to be busy for a while tomorrow." Chu Yi said calmly.
And the other side.
In the woods, in the river.
"Damn, a villain like Chu Er can't achieve anything big." The middle-aged man who was "dumped" got up from the river, straightened his neck and cursed.
He knew that he would "die" but he didn't expect that Chu Er, a hypocrite, would even pay lip service to the matter.
He actually didn't even give himself a dime of silver.
"Fortunately, I'm good at it." The middle-aged man shook the water off his body, walked slowly into the woods, and followed the path to Li's house.
Li family, lobby.
"What kind of skills do you have?" Li Junsu looked at the middle-aged man who was telling the story and straightened his expression.
He found that he seemed to underestimate the world. Being able to still jump around after his neck was broken was a bit appalling even in the world of high martial arts.
"It seems that in the future, the corpse will have to be destroyed to eliminate traces of murder." Li Junsu thought.
"This is a small chance for a villain." The middle-aged man said modestly.
"Yi Jin, he probably got the fragment or stole the master by chance. This is still rare." Li Wu explained looking at the serious Li Junsu.
"Hey, sir, you are really well-informed." The middle-aged man scratched his head in embarrassment.
"Changchun, give him another ten taels. I hope no one knows about this." Li Junsu first said to Li Changchun below, and then looked at the middle-aged man and said with a smile.
"Don't worry, Mr. Li, I won't show up in the suburbs until your plan is completed." Hearing this, the middle-aged man looked at Li Junsu seriously.
"Very good, you are a smart man, so leave your contact information. The Li family will be able to use you in the future." Li Junsu looked at the middle-aged man with satisfaction.
"I'm here" the middle-aged man said honestly from his home address.
"Very good, you can go." Li Junsu nodded and waved his hand.
Wait until the middle-aged man leaves.
"Master, let others go like this." Li Wu looked at Li Junsu and hesitated.
"Uncle Wu, don't worry. He just died at the hands of Chu Yi. Now go back." Li Junsu smiled and shook his head after hearing this.
Li Wu also came to his senses after hearing this.
This middle-aged man would be really dead if he ran back to report the news.
"Why do you always kill people and silence them?" Li Junsu thought helplessly as he looked at Li Wu and Li Changchun below.
But Li Junsu, who was planning to annihilate the Chu family, did not realize that he was the most ruthless person.
In Li Junsu's view, once the Chu family is in civil strife, no one from the Chu family, including servants old and young, will be left alive.
As long as he is not an enemy, then Li Junsu will have an admirable personality.
